meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 它把经典的单机器人 Slack 安装迁移成每个已有代理组各自一个独立的 slack-<slug> 机器人,保留代理身份、workspace、记忆和连线行为;也可以只记录你继续用经典 Slack 的选择(经典仍受支持)。全程由操作者确认,不新建代理组,不改代理 workspace。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack agents 要求时触发,之后也可随时单独运行 /migrate-slack-agents。它先检测经典状态,再给你「迁移」或「留在经典」的选择。

say.text: 帮我迁移经典 Slack agents
say.note: 先检测经典状态,再给出迁移选择

say.text: 先留在经典 Slack,不迁移
say.note: 不做改动,记录决定并确认更新要求

say.text: 确认这份迁移映射,继续执行
say.note: 按 dry-run 表逐组创建命名机器人

howto.what_en: Turns a classic single-bot Slack install into one provisioned slack-<slug> bot per existing agent group, keeping identities, workspaces, memory and wiring — or records your choice to stay on classic, which stays supported. Operator-guided; it never creates an agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or any time later on its own. It first detects classic state, then offers the choice to migrate or stay on classic.

say_en.note: Detects classic state, then offers the choice

say_en.text: Stay on classic Slack for now
say_en.note: Makes no changes, records the decision

say_en.text: Confirm this migration map and continue
say_en.note: Provisions one named bot per group
